options.content:
# 🔵 Base MEV · Validity Transaction Control Room
Follow the local path from **RPC/client admission → builder predicates → Flashblock selection → inclusion and fee value**. Blue is validity traffic, cyan is standard traffic, green is healthy, amber needs attention, and red is actionable. Rates use **$window**; summary charts use **p$quantile**.

panels.title: Triage · Is validity traffic flowing safely?

panels.description: Fraction of builder, client, and Base RPC Prometheus targets currently reachable. Check this before interpreting zeros or missing series.
panels.title: Core Targets

panels.description: Successfully completed L2 block builds per second. A gap with the builder target up indicates stalled construction.
panels.title: Build Throughput

panels.description: Share of included user transactions carrying validity predicates. The value is intentionally absent when no transactions were included; use throughput beside it to distinguish idle traffic.
panels.title: Validity Share

panels.description: Direct validity-transaction inclusion throughput from per-block observations. This is an endpoint signal, not a subtraction-based funnel estimate.
panels.title: Validity Included

panels.description: Invalid blocks built during the selected rate window. Any non-zero result requires immediate builder log and trace inspection.
panels.title: Invalid Blocks

panels.description: Status of the Tips ingress metrics endpoint. OFFLINE is expected for the standard devnet; ONLINE appears when the ingress overlay is running.
panels.title: Optional Ingress
Validity lifecycle · Where are transactions admitted, parked, rejected, and included?

panels.description: Successful validity admissions by node and outcome. Added and replaced measure pool activity, not unique end-to-end transactions; the same transaction may appear at several nodes.
panels.title: Validity Admissions by Node

panels.description: Direct included transaction throughput segmented by standard and validity flow. Both flow series emit zero observations for empty blocks.
panels.title: Included Transactions by Flow

panels.description: Builder predicate evaluations by outcome. Investigate read errors immediately; budget exhaustion means candidates were deferred to a later Flashblock rather than rejected.
panels.title: Predicate Outcomes

panels.description: Independent stage rates. Admission limits reject before pooling, invalidations evict tracked transactions, and prechecks drop stale manifests. Do not subtract these asynchronous counters as a transaction-exact funnel.
panels.title: Admission, Invalidation & Precheck Pressure
Flow economics · Which cohort earns inclusion and fee value?

panels.description: Priority-fee value directed to the builder and base-fee value represented by included gas, converted to ETH per second. Base fee is shown as burn/value and is not builder profit.
panels.title: Fee Value by Flow

panels.description: Transaction-weighted mean builder ordering score for included transactions, split by flow and bid mechanism. Empty cohorts remain absent rather than appearing as zero bids.

targets.expr: sum by (flow, bid) (rate(reth_base_builder_tip_per_gas_sum{job="l2_builder"}[$window])) / sum by (flow, bid) (rate(reth_base_builder_tip_per_gas_count{job="l2_builder"}[$window]))

panels.title: Mean Tip per Gas

panels.description: Observation-weighted mean included user transactions per block. These summary sums and counts include zero observations for empty flow cohorts.
panels.title: Transactions per Block

panels.description: Observation-weighted mean included gas per block, segmented by flow. Use the Flashblock headroom row to diagnose saturation.
panels.title: Gas per Block by Flow

panels.description: Selected local summary quantile for initial predicate evaluation and rescans. These quantiles come from the single devnet builder and are not aggregated across instances.
panels.title: Predicate Latency

panels.description: Mean account and storage reads for builds with predicate activity. These summaries intentionally omit builds with no predicate reads; widening total-versus-unique lines expose repeated state access.
panels.title: Predicate State Reads per Active Build
Predicate detail · Are validity conditions cheap, readable, and becoming satisfiable?

panels.description: Direct reader and forwarder stage rates by node. These are not a lossless funnel because batching, retries, deduplication, and multiple nodes can repeat a transaction.
panels.title: Node Intake → Builder

panels.description: Current transactions waiting in the destination channel or buffered for a batch. Sustained growth with flat forwarded throughput indicates backpressure.
panels.title: Forwarding Queue & Buffer

panels.description: Forwarding failures after retries plus successful calls with per-item builder rejection. Any sustained rate is actionable; the two families count different failure stages.
panels.title: Forwarding Faults

panels.description: Selected local summary quantiles for forwarding round trips and txpool validation. Keep each node and kind separate because exporter summary quantiles cannot be aggregated.
panels.title: Forwarding & Validation Latency
Forwarding detail · Does node demand reach the builder without pressure or retry loss?

panels.description: Observation-weighted mean cumulative gas headroom by Flashblock index. Headroom should decline as a block fills; early exhaustion indicates capacity pressure.
panels.title: Mean Gas Headroom by Flashblock

panels.description: Direct selection rejection rates by Flashblock index and reason. Deferred candidates are separate; do not derive rejection by subtracting considered and included transactions.
panels.title: Rejections by Flashblock & Reason

panels.description: Selected local summary quantile for builder stages that consume the 200 ms local Flashblock budget. The red threshold marks the configured interval, not a universal production limit.
panels.title: Flashblock Critical Path · p$quantile

panels.description: Selected summary quantile of Flashblocks omitted because construction started late or missed its schedule. Zero is healthy; sustained non-zero values indicate deadline pressure.
panels.title: Missing or Reduced Flashblocks
Flashblock capacity · Are selection passes on time and using gas efficiently?

panels.description: Share of observed included transactions with metering information. The value is absent when no metering decisions occurred; pending skips and late arrivals expose delivery races.
panels.title: Metering Coverage

panels.description: Rates of known/unknown metering decisions, pending skips, and late arrivals. Unknown, pending, or late events are degradation signals.
panels.title: Metering Activity

panels.description: Potential and enforced resource-budget violations by dimension and transaction/block scope. Limit-exceeded includes enforced throttles, so the series overlap and are not stacked.
panels.title: Resource Metering Decisions

panels.description: Selected local summary quantile for predicted execution time, signed prediction error, and actual execution time of unmetered transactions. All values are microseconds.
panels.title: Execution Metering Prediction · p$quantile
Metering & execution · Is the builder informed, accurate, and resource-safe?

panels.description: Messages received from the builder Flashblock stream by consumer node. A drop to zero with targets up suggests a disconnected or stalled stream.
panels.title: Flashblock Receive Rate

panels.description: Upstream errors, processing failures, unexpected order, reconnects, and stale drops. These should remain zero outside deliberate fault testing.
panels.title: Stream Integrity Events

panels.description: Selected local summary quantile for Flashblock processing by consumer. Keep each node separate because exporter summary quantiles are not aggregatable.
panels.title: Processing Latency · p$quantile
Consumer integrity · Do clients receive and process Flashblocks cleanly?

panels.description: Independent optional ingress transaction, bundle, and simulation rates. No data is expected when the ingress Compose overlay is not selected.
panels.title: Ingress Lifecycle Activity

panels.description: Selected ingress summary quantiles for simulation-side RPC methods and successful sendRawTransaction calls. Send latency is recorded only on the successful return path.
panels.title: Ingress RPC Latency · p$quantile

panels.description: Buffered metering responses plus failed simulations, metering deadline exceedances, and full audit channels. Correlated growth indicates delayed or failing ingress fan-out.
panels.title: Ingress Backpressure & Faults
Optional Tips ingress · Are bundles simulated, metered, and delivered on time?
